D2 cross-thread PC ownership guard trigger

Base:
d56f2177ea94419b8cda96f644f3e4f4ec958b9e

Physical proof from diagnostic ad4690db:
- cross-thread break route 0x203 captured PC=0x00007ff7b989a9d4
- same captured SP=0x00000020934f9810 remained guest-stack-owned
- LR=0x00007ff7b94f6094 was also host code
- existing logic therefore misclassified a host-code / guest-SP transition window as guest state
- SaveGuestState copied the host PC/LR into GuestContext
- immediate NCE_D2_CTX_INVALID_GUEST_PC followed

Production candidate:
- preserve patch-window handling first
- require suspended PC to be a valid guest process address before RedirectToHost(save_guest_state=true)
- invalid/non-guest PC is treated as host_window and retried by the existing SignalInterrupt loop
- no GuestContext/ASM/TEB/V74/HostMemory semantic changes

Closed regressions are not rerun.
